question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1490 (Inhibit System Recovery)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: The mitigations listed in ATT&CK for T1490 (Inhibit System Recovery) are M1028 (Operating System Configuration), M1053 (Data Backup), M1038 (Execution Prevention), and M1018 (User Account Management).
